skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on the target. [Internal Injury]: When the affected unit is attacked, takes DMG equal to 100% of Gouketsu's ATK. The effect disappears after triggering once.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 60% ATK DMG per strike. Restores HP equal to 20% of Max HP.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 70% ATK DMG per strike. Restores HP equal to 30% of Max HP.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Permanently gains 30% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], which reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility]. At battle start, increases Heal Rate and Shield Rate by 70% for self and surrounding allies for 2 turns.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Permanently gains 35% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], which reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility]. At battle start, increases Heal Rate and Shield Rate by 80% for self and surrounding allies for 2 turns.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Permanently gains 38% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], which reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility]. At battle start, increases Heal Rate and Shield Rate by 90% for self and surrounding allies for 2 turns.

effects.desc: Damage over time based on ST, disappears after activation; Can Detonate to explode.
